# infrawrench_savings_view (Resource)

A saved view over the savings findings list (Costs → Savings → Findings): a status tab, a filter and a sort, opened from the view picker in the app, `infrawrench savings findings --view <name>` in the CLI, or `?view=` on `GET /savings/findings`.

Every filter attribute is optional and an unset one does not filter. The view's creator owns it; share it with `infrawrench_object_sharing` (`object_type = "savings_view"`). Names are unique per organization, case-insensitively.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The open findings worth an afternoon: production, over $100 a month, biggest
# first. Opens from the view picker on Costs > Savings and from
# `infrawrench savings findings --view "Production waste"`.
resource "infrawrench_savings_view" "production_waste" {
  name        = "Production waste"
  description = "Open findings on production over $100 a month."
  status      = "open"

  kinds               = ["orphan", "oversized"]
  min_monthly_savings = 100

  tag {
    key    = "env"
    values = ["prod", "production"]
  }

  sort_field     = "savings"
  sort_direction = "desc"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name, 1–120 characters, unique in the organization.

### Optional

- `account_ids` (Set of String) Only findings on these connected accounts, by id (`infrawrench_account` ids, or the `infrawrench_accounts` data source). 1–200 values.
- `description` (String) Shown under the picker when the view is open. 1–2000 characters.
- `detected_from` (String) Only findings first detected on or after this day, `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC).
- `detected_to` (String) Only findings first detected on or before this day, `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC).
- `kinds` (Set of String) Only findings from these finders: `orphan` (orphaned or idle resources), `oversized` (right-sizing), `extended_support`, `seat` (unused SaaS seats). 1–200 values.
- `min_monthly_savings` (Number) Only findings saving at least this much per month, in each finding's own currency. Must be greater than zero; findings with no price never pass.
- `plugin_ids` (Set of String) Only findings from these providers, by plugin id (for example `aws`). 1–200 values.
- `regions` (Set of String) Only findings in these regions, as the provider names them. 1–200 values.
- `search` (String) Case-insensitive text matched against the finding, resource and account names. 1–200 characters.
- `sort_direction` (String) `desc` (the default) or `asc`.
- `sort_field` (String) `savings` (the default), `detected`, `name` or `status_changed`. Findings with no price always sort after priced ones.
- `status` (String) Which status tab the view opens on: `open` (Ready for review and In progress, the default), `ready`, `in_progress`, `completed`, `archived` or `all`.
- `tag` (Block List) Only findings whose resource carries this tag. Every block must match. 0–20 blocks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--tag))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned view id. Use it with `terraform import`.

<a id="nestedblock--tag"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tag`

Required:

- `key` (String) Tag key, matched case-insensitively. 1–200 characters.

Optional:

- `values` (Set of String) Any of these values. Leave unset to match any value of the key. 1–200 values.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id is in the --json output of `infrawrench savings views`, and in the
# response of GET /savings-views.
terraform import infrawrench_savings_view.example 2c3d4e5f-6a7b-8c9d-0e1f-2a3b4c5d6e7f
```
